messages:
Maya: FYI incoming CS ticket from Acme — multiple 503s on POST /v1/generate, spike started ~2026-02-11T16:23:40Z. Customer reports timeouts + partial responses, high error rate across several regions.
CS-Bot: Alert: hosted-api-prod /v1/generate 5xx-rate > 8% for 5m (16:23:30 - 16:28:30). Top upstream: infer-runner-us-west-2-1.
Ciaran: Thanks Maya. Do we have a reproducible curl or logs? Any recent deploys to infer-runner image?
Maya: Repro steps from CS (minimal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-13b","input":"repeat x1000","max_tokens":512}'
```
Customer says the request either times out (gateway) or returns 503 with upstream "worker exited". Attached full client logs to ticket.
Juan: I pulled runner logs from infer-runner-us-west-2-1 (pod infer-runner-7f8bcd). Snippet shows CUDA OOM then process abort.
```
[16:24:11] runtime: GPU0 memory 100% -> cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[16:24:12] runtime: kv-cache prefetch triggered size=12.1GB
[16:24:12] infer-runner: fatal: assert failed: cudaMalloc failed, aborting
[16:24:12] infer-runner: signal 6 (ABRT), core dumped
```
Elena: That's consistent with the dynbatch/kv-prefetch regression we saw on canary last week. Any chance the customer payload triggers extreme sequence expansion? Looks like prefetch + large max_tokens = > GPU mem.
Ciaran: Which image tag is this runner on? If it's the latest runtime with prefetch change we should rollback.
Juan: Running image: redwood/infer-runner:2026.02.09-e29d4c (the one that enabled aggressive kv-prefetch heuristics). Several pods on that image show similar OOMs at ~16:24.
Maya: Impact: Acme (high qps) + 2 other customers routed through same node pool. Estimated ~1200 requests failed in the 20m window. CS asked for ETA to mitigation.
Elena: Temporary mitigations to reduce customer impact:
- Disable kv-prefetch for the affected node pool (env VAR KV_PREFETCH=0)
- Route traffic off the pool (scale down or cordon)
- Apply runtime rollback to previous image that doesn't enable aggressive prefetch
Ciaran: I can patch the runtime config for that pool now. Juan can you confirm kube events and do a one-off cordon?
Juan: On it. Kube evts show OOMKilled pods and kubelet restarting container. Commands I'll run:
```
kubectl -n inference set env ds/infer-runner KV_PREFETCH=0 --selector=pool=us-west-2-prod
kubectl cordon node ip-10-8-45-33.us-west-2
kubectl rollout undo ds/infer-runner --to-image=redwood/infer-runner:2026.01.28-7c9a1b
```
Maya: CS informed and asked for root cause write-up + repro details. They can temporarily reduce max_tokens but prefer platform workaround.
Ciaran: Quick note — we should also collect core dumps + nvidia-smi output for one of the crashed pods for postmortem. Juan, can you `kubectl cp` the core and `nvidia-smi -q` from the node?
Juan: Yep. Collected core and appended GPU diagnostics. dmesg shows NV driver killed process due to out-of-memory at 16:24:12:
```
[Thu Feb 11 16:24:12] Out of memory: Kill process 32456 (infer-runner) score 987 or sacrifice child
[Thu Feb 11 16:24:12] nvidia: killing process 32456 (infer-runner) due to GPU OOM
```
Elena: Assigning to runtime-team for investigation of aggressive prefetch heuristics and better OOM handling. Please include: cache sizing, fallback to CPU/quantized path, and graceful failure instead of hard abort.
Maya: CS updated: temporary routing applied, errors dropped to normal baseline. Customer accepted temporary workaround but requested timeline for a fix and confirmation their historical requests won't be replayed.
Ciaran: Next steps for us (owners):
- Juan: confirm rollback fully completed and monitor 5xx-rate (owner: Juan, ETA 30m)
- Runtime: produce a patch to bound kv-prefetch size by free GPU mem + add graceful degraded path (owner: Elena -> runtime-team, ETA 72h for patch, 1wk for rollout)
- CS: send postmortem + repro + recommended mitigation to Acme (owner: Maya, ETA 2h)
Juan: Rollback done, cordon done, 5xx-rate back to baseline in us-west-2. Watching for ripple.
Elena: Filed runtime issue #RUNTIME-1184 with logs + core + nvml dump. Tagging @runtime-team for urgent prioritization.
Maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll close the CS ticket once docs are in and forward the postmortem.
CS-Bot: Incident summary created: INC-2026-02-11-8102468123 — mitigated (routing + rollback).
Ciaran: Leaving follow-up channel for postmortem notes. If anyone finds more reproductions, paste minimal payload + request id.
Maya: Copy — will paste repro payload and request ids to follow-up thread.
